title: TCP Server
text: Configure TCP server, 1 input, 1 output; {Use host-target connection} uses Ethernet connection between the development computer and target, {Server IP address} sets the iP address of the server device that is being configured, {Server port} sets the iP port of the server device that is being configured and {Use Nagle’s algorithm} enables Nagle. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Enable
ports.summary: Connect block to remote Ethernet device integer

ports.name: Status
ports.summary: Device returns a status of not connected or connected 0 | 1

params.name: Use host-target connection
params.values: Use Ethernet connection between the development computer and target computers ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Server IP address
params.values: IP address of the server device that is being configured x.x.x.x

params.name: Server port
params.values: IP port of the server device that is being configured 1–65535

params.name: Use Nagle’s algorithm
params.values: Enable Nagle’s algorithm to combine packets on (default) | off
